title: Incident #4538 — Sales Data Discrepancy Detected!
scenario: The operations team reports that the weekly sales summary shows an unusually high number of returns. Find the bug.
code:
SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns,
    SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM
    orders
WHERE
    order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY
    product_id

options.text: The calculation for total_sales is incorrect.
The status check does not account for 'completed' orders.
The date filter is excluding some necessary records.
The GROUP BY clause is missing product_id.

explanation: The bug lies in the logic for calculating total_returns. It only counts amounts when the status is 'returned', but it fails to ensure that only completed orders are included in total_sales. This could lead to discrepancies when calculating the returns against total sales. Fix it by adding a condition for completed orders in the total_sales calculation.
